messages:
incident-bot: P1: High tail latency detected on inference fleet (us-west). Automatic pager triggered. https://redwood.status/incidents/5201234567 :rotating_light:

jay (oncall): seeing it, joining now. pinging ops for backup.

maria (eng): I'm up — will take initial ownership for triage. starting quick perf checks on pods + kvcache.

sasha (eng-sre): war room? I can spin a short huddle and collect logs. creating a meet link.

incident-bot: Warroom created: https://meet.redwood/warroom-5201234567 (ops bridge) — recording enabled.

jay (oncall): ack. rolling logs: `kubectl -n inference logs -l app=inference --tail=200` shows `KV cache pressure` warnings and CPU spike on node g4-05.

maria (eng): confirmed high KV cache miss rate from 12:02:13 UTC. hypothesizing prefix caching eviction due to batch size changes.

kevin (product-ops): customer-impact quick check: any 5xx? statuspage?

jay (oncall): some 500s for a subset of requests — error rate ~1.8% last 5m. overall latency p99 jumped to ~3.2s from 0.6s.

priya (customer-comm): draft for status page / customer note: 1) concise impact, 2) mitigation steps, 3) ETA next update. propose: 
```
We are investigating increased latency and intermittent errors affecting model inference in us-west. Some requests may see higher latency or failures. Engineers are actively mitigating. We will post updates every 15 minutes.
```

maria (eng): mitigation plan: 1) reduce batch size ramp for fastest nodes (immediate), 2) enable graceful fallback to small-quant model variant for high-latency requests, 3) increase kvcache size on g4-05 (if safe). I'll start 1 and 2 now.

sasha (eng-sre): re routing: adding temporary rule to route new sessions to eu and us-east until we stabilise. policy change pushed to staging, will promote in 2m.

jay (oncall): performing manual canary: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'` against fallback — baseline latency ~420ms. Good.

maria (eng): applied batch size change on assignment group `inference-fast`. KV cache increase requires node restart; deferring unless needed. Monitoring.

kevin (product-ops): updating status page with Priya's draft + note about regional mitigation and ETA 15m.

priya (customer-comm): sending short email to top impacted customers after first update; will add a link to status page. cc: kevin.

jay (oncall): current telemetry: error rate down to 0.6%, p99 down to 1.1s. continuing to watch for 10m.

maria (eng): assigning followups: Maria -> triage root cause; Sasha -> routing/proxy rules; Jay -> monitoring & alerts tuning; Priya/Keven -> external comms.

priya (customer-comm): noted. I'll stash the customer note template in the warroom doc: https://docs.redwood/warroom/5201234567-comms (short updates every 15m).

incident-bot: Pager acknowledged by jay at 12:04:21 UTC. Warroom active.

kevin (product-ops): thanks team — please post final resolution + RCA link in this thread when stable.

maria (eng): will post RCA draft once we've confirmed whether KV eviction or kernel scheduling is root cause. next update in ~10m.
